scoring_justification: Checker recomputes quadratic response surface model from hidden design matrix and finds optimal FSP parameters and predicted tensile strength, then compares agent's results.

hidden_assets.purpose: Box-Behnken design matrix with 17 runs (A: tool passes, B: rotational speed, C: transverse speed) and measured tensile strengths.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 2, columns: A (number of tool pass), B (rotational speed rpm), C (transverse speed mm/min), tensile strength (MPa).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from published Table 2 of the paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The data is the actual experimental design matrix used in the paper's response surface analysis; it is the ground truth for model fitting.

steps.description: Check optimal parameters and predicted tensile strength against recomputed optimum from design matrix.
Check model comparison metrics (deviation, improvement) and consistency with optimum file.

outputs.description: Optimal friction stir process parameters and the predicted tensile strength at those settings, to be compared against the paper's reported optimum.
Comparison metrics: model deviation from experimental confirmation and composite improvement over base material.

output_contract.notes: Hardness improvement is not included because there is no accompanying regression model for hardness. The task focuses solely on the tensile strength modeling and optimization.
